Check Yourself

Is Your Account at Risk?

If any of these sound familiar, don’t wait — these are the signs I see right before accounts get taken.

8 warning signs — be honest with yourself

One sign is enough to get a checkup. Two or more means urgent.

  • !
    You got a strange login alert — a city or device you don’t recognise.
  • !
    Your password is old or reused — same password on Instagram and other apps.
  • !
    2FA is off, or only by SMS — no authenticator app, no backup codes saved.
  • !
    Old email or phone on the account — you can’t receive codes on them anymore.
  • !
    Someone made a fake account of you — your photos, your name, messaging your followers.
  • !
    You clicked a “verify / copyright” link — from a DM or email that looked like Instagram.
  • !
    An old phone is still logged in — a sold, lost or shared device that can still open your account today.
  • !
    Your email isn’t protected either — whoever gets into your email can reset your Instagram in minutes.

Recognised even one? Send me a DM with a screenshot — I’ll tell you honestly what it means and what to do first. No panic, just steps.

Free — Do It Today

6 Things to Do Right Now

Even before you message me — these six take minutes and stop most attacks.

1

Turn on 2FA with an app

Settings → Accounts Centre → Password and security → Two-factor authentication. Choose authentication app, not only SMS.

2

Save your backup codes

Screenshot is not enough — write them down and keep them somewhere safe at home.

3

Check “Where you’re logged in”

Remove every device and city you don’t recognise. If you see a stranger — change your password immediately.

4

Never tap “verify” links in DMs

Instagram never asks for your password by DM or email link. Real warnings appear inside the app’s settings only.

5

Switch on login alerts

Settings → Accounts Centre → Password and security → Login alerts. A new sign-in pings you instantly — so a stranger never stays silent.

6

Never type your password outside the app

“Free followers”, “blue tick” and “copyright” pages that ask for your password are stealing accounts. If a page wants it, close the page.

Be Ready

Before You Message

Have these ready — it makes everything faster

One short message with these four things is enough to start:

  • Your username — the exact @ of the account you want secured
  • What you need — checkup, 2FA setup, or full securing
  • Any warning you saw — a screenshot of any strange login or message, if you have one
  • Access to your email & phone — the ones on the account, so login codes can actually reach you during the session

Questions

Frequently Asked

Tap a question to open the answer.

Do I need to give you my password?
We go step by step together and I explain everything before anything changes. Never send your password to anyone who messages you first claiming to be me — only contact me through @sir.d4na from this page.
How long does a full securing take?
It depends on your account’s condition — a clean account is fast, an account with old email/phone or strange logins needs more care. In the first DM I’ll tell you honestly what yours needs, before we start.
Can you help business & shop accounts?
Yes — shops, creators and business pages are exactly where security matters most, because the account is the business. Linked Facebook and business settings are checked too.
Someone made a fake account of me. What now?
Send me the fake account’s @ in a DM. I’ll guide you through reporting it the right way and we’ll secure your real account so followers can clearly tell you are the original.
Which languages do you work in?
Kurdish (Sorani), Arabic and English. Message me in whichever you prefer — I reply in the same language.
I got a strange login alert — is it already too late?
Not necessarily — but don’t wait. Change your password from inside the app, check “Where you’re logged in”, then DM me a screenshot of the alert and I’ll tell you the next step.
I lost my phone — am I locked out forever?
Usually not — this is exactly why backup codes matter. If you saved yours, you can get back in and set up 2FA on the new phone. If you didn’t, message me and I’ll walk you through Instagram’s official recovery steps, in the right order.
Do you check my linked Facebook too?
Yes — if your Instagram is linked to a Facebook profile or Page, that link is part of your security. A weak Facebook login can be a back door into Instagram, so in a full securing we check both sides.
